subject.title: [Bug]: iOS bottom tab bar (Chat/Talk/Control/Agent/Settings) hidden when keyboard is open

question: While the Chat composer is focused, should the iPhone app keep the full root tab bar accessible above the keyboard, or preserve the current keyboard-covered layout and add a different navigation/dismissal affordance?
rationale: Current source defines no keyboard-time root-navigation contract, and the alternatives trade persistent cross-app navigation against reduced chat space and native keyboard conventions.

options.title: Keep navigation accessible
options.body: Keep the root tabs, or an equivalent always-visible tab switcher, usable while typing so changing sections does not require dismissing the keyboard.

options.title: Add explicit dismissal
options.body: Retain the current keyboard-covered tab layout but add a clear keyboard dismissal control or gesture before users can switch sections.

recommendation.title: Keep navigation accessible
recommendation.body: Keep the root tabs, or an equivalent always-visible tab switcher, usable while typing so changing sections does not require dismissing the keyboard.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work crosses the iOS root and shared chat boundaries where this UX contract must be implemented safely.
